title: fixing-accessibility
purpose: Review and fix UI accessibility violations with targeted, minimal patches covering ARIA attributes, semantic HTML, keyboard access, focus management, and form error linking.
when: When adding or changing buttons, links, inputs, menus, dialogs, tabs, dropdowns, forms, validation, error states, focus states, focus trapping, modal behavior, icon-only controls, or hover-only interactions.

title: fixing-metadata
purpose: Audit and fix metadata that impacts accessibility, route clarity, indexing, social previews, locale correctness, and assistive technology context.
when: When adding or changing page titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, robots directives, Open Graph or Twitter card metadata, app manifest, theme-color, JSON-LD, locale declarations, alternate languages, or route-level head tags.

title: fixing-motion-performance
purpose: Diagnose and fix animation issues while preserving reduced-motion accessibility, focus stability, and smooth performance under real interaction load.
when: When adding or changing UI animations (CSS, WAAPI, Motion, rAF, GSAP), remediating vestibular-risk interactions, fixing scroll-linked motion, or debugging animation-triggered focus and scroll jumps.

title: screen-reader-testing
purpose: Run structured screen reader testing workflows (VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS, TalkBack) across forms, dialogs, tabs, dynamic updates, and task completion paths.
when: When validating screen reader compatibility, testing ARIA implementations, debugging spoken output issues, verifying dialog/form behavior, or checking dynamic announcement quality.

title: ui-visual-validator
purpose: Verify visual output of accessibility changes with measurable checks for focus visibility, contrast, target size, zoom behavior, and responsive integrity.
when: When validating post-fix visual quality, design-system conformance, dark mode or forced-colors rendering, text spacing resilience, and responsive regressions.

title: wcag-audit-patterns
purpose: Execute WCAG 2.2 audit methodology with automated/manual balance, sampling strategy, criterion mapping, and remediation prioritization.
when: When conducting accessibility audits, preparing compliance programs, planning remediation by severity, or establishing acceptance gates before release.

title: wcag-audit-reporting
purpose: Produce governance-ready accessibility audit outputs including severity taxonomy, evidence packs, remediation backlog ownership, retesting, and compliance summaries.
when: When an audit must be delivered to engineering, product, legal, procurement, or executive stakeholders with traceable WCAG mapping and retest criteria.

title: assistive-tech-edge-cases
purpose: Investigate and remediate failures that emerge only in assistive technology combinations, alternate input modes, and high-stress interaction contexts.
when: When baseline screen reader checks pass but users report failures involving speech control, switch input, zoom, forced colors, gesture conflicts, live region overload, or dynamic focus recovery.
